summary: LQR House Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an additional closing under a Share Purchase Agreement with Fusion Five Continents Securities Limited, a New Zealand company, and seller Dean Shields. LQR acquired 3,000 shares (30%) for $39,000,000 in Tether (USDT), increasing its total stake to 54% (5,400 shares), achieving majority ownership. The agreement was initially disclosed in an April 2026 8-K, and no board recommendation or advisor is named in this filing. Consideration was paid in crypto USDT, not cash. This is a staged acquisition of a cross-border brokerage. Watch for regulatory approval (cross-border financial services) and settlement mechanics given USDT-based consideration; risk-arb centers on valuation of the remaining 46% and subsequent closings.
